newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells out 45 bln levs 3-, 6-mth T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells out 45 bln levs 3-, 6-mth T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance ministry issues of three- and six-month discount T-bills were sold out at Monday's auctions, yielding 2.55 and 4.99 percent to maturity, respectively, central bank figures showed.
The average yields to maturity of the two respective issues auctioned on May 16 stood at 3.80 and 6.79 percent.

The three-month issue was offered with a par value of 25 billion levs and the six-month T-bills were offered with a par of 20 billion levs. Both issues were offered with no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 25,000 million levs 20,000 million levs
Bids received 45,685.1 million levs 68,744.4 million levs
Average price of bids 96.87 pct 93.77 pct
Bids approved 25,000 million levs 20,000 million levs
Average yield to maturity 2.55 pct 4.99 pct
